en.headline: National Day fireworks display held over Victoria Harbour
en.dek: The 23-minute show began at 8pm with 31,888 shells, as police had expected about 260,000 people on both sides of the harbour.
body: Hong Kong staged its National Day fireworks over Victoria Harbour at 8pm on Thursday, marking the 77th anniversary of the founding of the People's Republic of China. The Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau coordinated the display, which ran for about 23 minutes.

Organisers said 31,888 shells were fired from nine points on three barges and six pontoons. The show, themed around radiance over the harbour, was sponsored by Sun Life Hong Kong. Police had said they expected about 260,000 people to watch from both shores.

Road closures and crowd controls on Hong Kong Island and in Kowloon were already in force before the display. The Marine Department had set a sea exclusion zone off the Convention and Exhibition Centre until about 10pm, and a central-harbour restriction from 7pm. Officials had said the restriction was expected to lift about 30 to 45 minutes after the show.
The MTR had closed selected exits at Tsim Sha Tsui, East Tsim Sha Tsui and West Kowloon to match police crowd controls. Land boundary checkpoints were not given extended hours for the evening.

zh.headline: 國慶煙花匯演維港上演 歷時約23分鐘
zh.dek: 煙花晚上8時開始，發放31,888枚煙花；警方預計約26萬人在兩岸觀賞。
body: 為慶祝中華人民共和國成立77周年，國慶煙花匯演周四晚上8時在維多利亞港上空舉行，歷時約23分鐘。匯演由文化體育及旅遊局統籌。
主辦方表示，三艘蹚船及六艘小浮船共九個發放點，合共發放31,888枚煙花。今次主題為「永明煙花 綻放中華」，由香港永明金融贊助。警方預計約26萬人在兩岸觀賞。
港島及九龍多區在匯演前已分階段封路及實施人潮管制。海事處在會展對開海面設禁區至約晚上10時，維港中部則由晚上7時起實施限制區。當局早前表示，限制區預計於匯演完結後約30至45分鐘解封。
港鐵為配合警方人潮管制，曾關閉尖沙咀、尖東及西九龍站部分出口。陸路口岸當晚沒有延長開放時間。
